entries.title: 炫酷机甲 / EMBER
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished landscape industrial-design concept sheet reinterpreting the attached reference robot, not a CAD drawing. Reference image is structural and cockpit-style reference. Preserve a compact hobby-size six-legged NodeHexa robot with exactly three legs per side, three rotary hobby-servo joints per leg, same approximate linkage lengths, original local screw/servo mounting structures unchanged in intent. Widen the CENTRAL CHASSIS LEFT-TO-RIGHT moderately; do NOT lengthen front-to-back. Focus most new styling on the legs and chassis exterior. Keep a detachable central cockpit derived from reference, faceted tinted face canopy, narrow illuminated eyes, small camera low on front, side vents. No phone installed during walking. Show full robot in a large front three-quarter hero view occupying left 65%, with smaller aligned top view upper right (six legs clearly counted) and isolated single-leg styling detail lower right. Consistent design in all views. Neutral light gray studio background, excellent soft product lighting with all details visible even on dark materials, sharp realistic materials, subtle FDM texture, assembly seams, accessible fasteners. No human, no giant robot, no extra legs or duplicated limbs, no impossible floating parts, no weapons, no busy environment. English title only at top, small 'CONCEPT • NOT DIMENSIONED' at bottom. Each design must be distinctly different in geometry not merely color.  Design direction: 炫酷机甲 / EMBER. Graphite gray angular layered armor with vivid orange inset panels, precise chamfers and mechanical ventilation slots, amber narrow eyes. Redesigned legs with tapered angular shin armor and strong geometric cutouts, plausible exposed original hobby servo joint locations. Premium manufactured mecha, not weaponized.
